# third_party/3dgs

Clone the ORIGINAL 3D Gaussian Splatting repository here, e.g.:

    git clone https://github.com/graphdeco-inria/gaussian-splatting .

Do NOT edit files in this directory. All of our modifications live in `src/`
and are applied by importing from this repo, so the your-code / their-code
boundary the grading asks for stays clean.
